newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot jet prices near flat in lackluster trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot jet prices near flat in lackluster trade.

text.p: U.S. jet fuel prices drifted sideways Thursday in modest market activity, according to market players.
"There's not a whole lot shaking," one trader said. Many participants were attending industry functions which kept market activity thin.
U.S. Gulf prompt 54-grade jet fuel barrels changed hands at 1.00 cent under the June heating oil futures, on the upper end of the range seen late Wednesday.
New York Harbor prompt 54-grade jet fuel was talked at about 1.25 cents over June futures.
On the NYMEX, June heating oil settled up 0.06 cent on the day.
